description_en: Invokes the AssociateHaVip operation to attach an HaVip to an ECS instance or elastic network interface (ENI) in a virtual private cloud (VPC)
description_zh: 调用AssociateHaVip接口将HaVip绑定到专有网络ECS实例或弹性网卡上
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-ha-vip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ha-vip-id havip-2zeo05qre24nhrqpy0000 --instance-id i-faf344422ffsfad0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateHaVip

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the HaVip.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
HaVip所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HaVip to be associated
parameters.name: ha_vip_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance to attach to the HaVip
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance to attach to the HaVip. Valid values:

EcsInstance: ECS instance.

NetworkInterface: elastic network interface (ENI). If the instance to attach to the HaVip is an ENI, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定HaVip的实例类型，取值：

EcsInstance：云服务器ECS实例。

NetworkInterface：弹性网卡实例，当绑定HaVip的实例为弹性网卡，该参数必须填写
parameters.name: instance_type
